sn21.7:1.1: Evam me sutaṃ || ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Vesāliyaṃ viharati Mahāvane kuṭāgārasalāyaṃ || || Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Visākho pañcālaputto upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ bhikkhū dhammikāya kathāya sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti || poriyā vācāya vissaṭṭhāya anelagaḷāya atthassa viññāpaniyā pariyāpannāya anissitāya || ||
sn21.7:2.1: Atha kho Bhagavā sāyaṇha samayam paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yena upaṭṭhānasālā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi || || Nisajja kho Bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi || || Ko nu kho bhikkhave upaṭṭhānasālāyam bhikkhū dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti poriyā vācāya vissaṭṭhāya anelagaḷāya atthassa viññāpaniyā pariyāpannāya anissitāyā ti || || Āyasmā bhante Visākho pañcālaputto upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ bhikkhū dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti poriyā vācāya vissaṭṭhāya anelagaḷāya atthassa viññāpaniyā pariyāpannāya anissitāyāti || ||
sn21.7:3.1: Atha kho Bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Visākham pañcālaputtam āmantesi || || Sādhu sādhu Visākha || sādhu kho tvaṃ Visākha bhikkhū dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi || pe|| atthassa viññāpaniyā pariyāpannāya anissitāyā ti || ||
sn21.7:4.1: Idam avoca Bhagavā || Idaṃ vatvāna Sugato athāparam etad avoca satthā || ||
sn21.7:5.1: No bhāsamānaṃ jānanti || missam bālehi paṇḍitaṃ || bhāsamānañca jānanti || desentam amatam padam ||1||
sn21.7:6.1: Bhāsaye jotaye dhammam || paggaṇhe isinaṃ dhajaṃ || subhāsitadhajā isayo || dhammo hi isinaṃ dhajo ti ||2|| Sattamaṃ || ||
